head: Any Day Now: a countdown app for iPhone with widgets and Live Activities
dek: Any Day Now counts down to trips, exams, birthdays and other dates, each with its own colours or a cover photo. It was #54 in Productivity on the US App Store's paid chart on 17 November.
details: It costs $0.99, with no account, ads or subscription, and keeps your countdowns on your device. You get all-day or timed countdowns, repeats every week, month or year, month, week and year calendars, and small or medium Home Screen widgets. In a timed event's last eight hours it can show the countdown on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island. It came out on 16 November from MAXXSOFTWARE Inc.
means: If you keep checking how many days are left until a trip or an exam, this puts the number on your Home Screen.
todo: Allow notifications if you want its reminders, and open the app now and then so repeating reminders stay scheduled.
